narrative.details: One of the letters on this table is encrypted and inscrutable.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Encrypted Letter to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.
narrative.offerRewardText:
What is this? Hold a moment... let me take a closer look.

...

Hm, I have never before seen this form of encryption, but I must admit that my knowledge in that area is by no means complete.
narrative.requestItemsText: Yes, adventurer? Do you have some business with me?
